title: 第7章 濒临死境第8章 误入禁忌之地
content_zh:
巨大的蓝色异能球，直冲而来，将周围的空气扯开，“轰隆！”
一声，打到应无悔身体上，顿时皮开肉绽，筋骨寸断。
这一击硬生生地打断了应无悔的右腿，剧痛蹿心，他脸色发白，牙关紧紧咬住，没有喊叫一声！
“庶民，骨气可真硬，我喜欢，哈哈哈”
右手再次凝聚巨大的异能球，这一击废你左腿！
焱言瞄准好，奋力一扔，精准命中，应无悔又吃下这一击，钻心的疼痛，已经让他生不如死，换别的人早就晕死过去，或者当场死亡，而应无悔却要清晰的体验这种生不如死的感觉。
最后一发，凝聚完这一击，体内的异能，消耗的也差不多了，这学堂小小的奖励，我根本不感兴趣，还不如玩弄你开心！
巨型蓝色能量球，轰断了应无悔的右臂，焱言满意的离场，拿到三分，装个样子，毕竟我也算是学长，这排名让他们争！
应无悔浑身是血，他艰难地睁着眼睛，看着这些人冷酷麻木嗤笑的嘴脸，复仇的种子已深埋心里，不仅仅是为了自己和好朋友胖福，也是为了被欺压蹂躏的苦命人！
李典在稻草人测试中拿到八分，为本科目最高分。
她使用异能平稳有节奏，蓝色异能球搓在手中稳稳控制，再瞄准掷出一气呵成，每一击都击倒稻草人和被挷着的奴隶。
她的眼神冷冷的，杀伐果断，从不担心什么。
教老们只觉得惊叹，此人炎门定要大力栽培。
稻草人测试结束了，1到10名分别是：李典，焱梦葳，焱傅韩，焱小昂，焱言，益萌……教老们只宣布了前五名，毕竟后面还有两个项目，一个项目分最高，不代表三个项目加起来最高。
“第二项测试内容：控物”
教老们说完，就带着弟子们过去了。
绑着的奴隶被松下来，侍卫们不屑他查探他们的生死情况“活着的，就带回去医治，死了的，要么扔掉，要么埋掉”
侍卫头领说道。
“这小子，虽然断手断脚但还有呼吸，不过这种残废的，直接扔到山涯下面去吧，也可以让我省时省力些”
侍卫拖起应无悔和已经僵硬的胖福身休，朝山崖上走，一脚下去，爽！

头也不回地回去继续清理。
“五十个人里面，还有五个人有用，带回去”
头领命令手下道。
手下们极不情愿地拖着这些脏兮兮的人回到后勤食堂，让沈娘一个人医治他们。
沈娘正在食堂里指挥厨师和送饭莱伙夫，正午之前必须送到学堂大食堂，这里油烟翻腾，菜不断滋拉翻炒着，厨师们满头大汗，却一丝都不敢懈怠。
侍卫头领命令沈娘救好这几个人，然后就走了。
content_en:
The huge blue energy ball rushed straight towards it, tearing apart the surrounding air, "Boom!"
With a loud sound, he hit Ying Wuhui's body, and his skin and flesh were immediately torn open, and his muscles and bones were broken.
This blow forcefully broke Ying Wuhui's right leg. The pain was so severe that his face turned pale and he clenched his teeth tightly without making a single cry!
"Common people, you have such a strong backbone, I like it, hahaha"
The huge ball of supernatural power is once again condensed in your right hand. This blow will destroy your left leg!
Yan Yan took good aim, threw it hard, and hit it accurately. Ying Wuhui took another blow. The heartbreaking pain had already made him worse than death. Anyone else would have fainted or died on the spot, but Ying Wuhui had to clearly experience this feeling of life being worse than death.
After the last shot, after condensing this blow, the superpower in the body has been consumed. I am not interested in this small reward from the school at all. I might as well have fun playing with you!
The giant blue energy ball broke off Ying Wuhui's right arm. Yan Yan left the field satisfied, got three points, and pretended, after all, I am also a senior, and this ranking is for them to compete for!
Ying Wuhui was covered in blood. He opened his eyes with difficulty and looked at the cold, numb and sneering faces of these people. The seeds of revenge were buried deep in his heart, not only for himself and his good friend Fatty, but also for the poor people who were oppressed and ravaged!
Li Dian scored eight points in the scarecrow test, the highest score in this subject.
She used her powers smoothly and rhythmically. She rubbed the blue power ball in her hands and controlled it steadily. Then she aimed and threw it in one go, knocking down the scarecrow and the slave being held down with every blow.
Her eyes were cold and decisive, and she never worried about anything.
The elders were just amazed, this person must be cultivated by the Yan Sect.
The scarecrow test is over. The 1st to 10th places are: Li Dian, Yan Mengwei, Yan Fuhan, Yan Xiaoang, Yan Yan, Yimeng... The teachers only announced the top five. After all, there are two more projects behind. One project has the highest score, but it does not mean that the sum of the three projects has the highest.
"Second test content: control of objects"
After the elders finished speaking, they led the disciples over.
The tied slaves were untied, and the guards disdained him to check their life and death status. "Those who are alive, take them back for treatment, and those who are dead, either throw them away or bury them."
The leader of the guards said.
"This kid, although his arms and legs are broken, is still breathing. However, if he is so disabled, just throw him under the mountain. It will also save me time and effort."
The guards dragged Ying Wuhui and the already stiff Fat Fu Shenxiu up the cliff, and stepped down. It was great!
Go back and continue cleaning without looking back.
"Among the fifty people, there are still five useful ones, take them back."
The leader ordered his men.
The subordinates reluctantly dragged these dirty people back to the logistics canteen and let Shen Niang treat them alone.
Shen Niang is directing the chefs and cooks in the cafeteria. They must deliver the food to the school cafeteria before noon. The oil smoke is billowing here, the dishes are constantly being stir-fried, and the chefs are sweating profusely, but they dare not slack off at all.
The leader of the guards ordered Shen Niang to save these people and then left.
